Ja det känns eftersom det är hög
viktpunkt och den jassar när man kör.

22
00:07:40,240 --> 00:07:43,020
Känslan är ibland att den kan välta.

23
00:07:43,020 --> 00:07:46,660
Sista rundan jag körde höll jag på köra över fotocellen.

24
00:07:46,660 --> 00:07:49,125
Framhjulen är inte ofta i marken.

25
00:07:49,125 --> 00:07:54,040
Så man måste planera om man ska svänga.

26
00:07:54,040 --> 00:07:57,580
Det är kul, en skräckblandad förtjusning.

27
00:07:57,600 --> 00:07:59,400
-Varför Speed Weekend?

28
00:07:59,400 --> 00:08:04,500
Jag såg att Hubbe Berg hade
byggt en trädgårdstraktor.

29
00:08:04,500 --> 00:08:08,000
Jag blev influerad och tyckte det var en cool grej.

30
00:08:08,020 --> 00:08:10,720
Det är väl tack vare honom.

31
00:08:10,720 --> 00:08:13,580
Det är ett jättebra evenemang det här.

32
00:08:13,580 --> 00:08:17,360
Jag gillar sånt här och jag tävlar för mig själv.

33
00:08:23,500 --> 00:08:26,580
-Är det bara jag som tycker det här ser livsfarligt ut?

34
00:08:29,300 --> 00:08:31,700
Stopp, stopp, stopp!!

35
00:08:35,560 --> 00:08:37,560
Stopp, stopp, stopp!!

36
00:09:16,420 --> 00:09:19,120
Den bilen har överlevt än så länge.

37
00:09:19,700 --> 00:09:22,300
Men, nja äh..

38
00:09:22,300 --> 00:09:25,960
Roliga lastningar ska man ha.
-Det såg läskigt ut.

39
00:09:25,960 --> 00:09:28,295
Ja, tanken var god.

40
00:09:28,295 --> 00:09:31,165
Precis efter jag har tagit den
här bilden så vek sig rampen.

41
00:09:31,165 --> 00:09:34,015
Vi fick förstärka rampen under.

42
00:09:34,015 --> 00:09:37,265
Nu väger ramperna 60 kg styck.

43
00:09:37,760 --> 00:09:41,580
Man lär sig så länge man lever.
Och går det åt helvete så går det åt helvete.

44
00:09:41,580 --> 00:09:44,000
Det är ganska enkelt att byta växellådan här.

45
00:12:43,640 --> 00:12:48,220
100 km/h är det magiska nr för alla min fordon.

46
00:12:48,220 --> 00:12:55,700
Snabbare än 105,2 km/h skulle jag vilja åka för
det gjorde Mobacken racing för länge sedan.

47
00:12:55,700 --> 00:12:58,480
Det vore en milstolpe att slå deras rekord.

48
00:13:02,925 --> 00:13:05,795
-Vi kan väl kommentera hur mycket det låter?

49
00:13:05,795 --> 00:13:09,045
-Hur lång ifrån kan vi vara 300 meter?
Det är vi nog.

50
00:13:09,045 --> 00:13:13,220
300 meter i från och nu ska
Svarthålet starta pulsjet skotern.

51
00:13:13,220 --> 00:13:15,340
Det tror jag att vi gör.

52
00:13:15,780 --> 00:13:19,280
Framförallt känns det i kroppen.

53
00:13:19,780 --> 00:13:24,300
Jag vet att det hörs hela vägen till Sandviken. (1,5 mil)

54
00:14:16,640 --> 00:14:24,720
Som kurriosa så har inte motortypen
används sedan 40-talet till något vettigt.

55
00:14:24,720 --> 00:14:30,000
Och den användes inte till något vettigt på 40-talet heller för tyskarna hade den till V1-missilen.

56
00:14:30,000 --> 00:14:33,160
Det är väl det som är det mest kända...

57
00:14:33,860 --> 00:14:36,640
...applikationen som har använt stora pulsjetmotorer.

58
00:14:36,980 --> 00:14:40,360
Dom användes med varierande framgång.

59
00:14:40,360 --> 00:14:44,200
Tyskarna sköt många mot
England och vissa kom fram.

60
00:14:44,360 --> 00:14:48,460
V1-missilen kallades för
"buzz bomb" pga hur dom låter.

61
00:14:48,460 --> 00:14:51,760
Det finns nog fortfarande människor
som var med och kan vittna om ljudet.

62
00:14:51,760 --> 00:14:54,560
Det var nog ganska skräck injagade kan jag tänka mig.

63
00:15:39,620 --> 00:15:44,640
Motorn blir 4-5 cm längre när den är varm
och sedan ökar även diametern.

64
00:15:44,640 --> 00:15:46,380
Så det sliter av motorfästena.

65
00:15:46,380 --> 00:15:52,860
Det som ser bra ut är att vi inte har hittat några skador på varken fästen eller motor efter den här helgen.

66
00:15:52,860 --> 00:15:55,020
Och det känns bra.

67
00:15:55,020 --> 00:16:00,040
Vi gjorde inga prestanda ökningar inför i år
utan la all energi på motorfästena.

68
00:16:00,040 --> 00:16:02,140
Och det ser ut att ha lyckats.

69
00:16:02,140 --> 00:16:06,580
Vi får lön för mödan när man sitter i
CAD-programmet och klurar och diskuterar.

70
00:16:06,580 --> 00:16:09,120
Det blir mycket debatt oss i mellan.

71
00:16:09,580 --> 00:16:11,220
Och oftast blir det bra.
files.Motornörd || Sven Billreds udda 2019 Elm:
1
00:00:45,780 --> 00:00:47,700
Tjena, Douglas.
Sven Billred.

2
00:00:48,160 --> 00:00:52,340
-I have heard that you are going to do a project?
Yes it is true.

3
00:00:52,340 --> 00:00:57,780
-When should it be finished?
Hopefully to Elmia 2019.

4
00:00:59,220 --> 00:01:00,860
It should go.

5
00:01:00,860 --> 00:01:05,520
-Is there any sketch on what it should look like?

6
00:01:05,520 --> 00:01:08,320
Well, most of it is already in the head.

7
00:01:08,320 --> 00:01:12,340
But then I found a picture on the internet on a car.

8
00:01:12,340 --> 00:01:14,940
This one is quite similar.

9
00:01:14,940 --> 00:01:18,780
I will not use any bonnet or screens.

10
00:01:18,780 --> 00:01:24,600
The style itself will be like this with Boat-tail at the back and the front with similar lanterns.

11
00:01:24,600 --> 00:01:29,100
-What do you have for background?
The fact that you have built more cars can prove the wall.

12
00:01:29,100 --> 00:01:35,600
Well, I have built a 1927 Chevrolet that I have used for 10 years.

13
00:01:35,600 --> 00:01:43,880
I also have a Willys from 1939 which was a 4 door that I have built into a coupe.

14
00:01:43,880 --> 00:01:48,180
Exactly after the original.
And that's the only one in Sweden.

15
00:01:48,180 --> 00:01:54,200
There are some Willys Cuper from 1940-41 but they are unusual.

16
00:01:54,200 --> 00:01:58,900
-Cool!
If you are wondering what sounds, it is a fluorescent lamp that creak.

17
00:01:58,900 --> 00:02:03,740
It's an old garage.
I've been here for over 30 years.

18
00:02:03,740 --> 00:02:06,420
It probably needed to be renovated.

19
00:02:06,420 --> 00:02:08,500
-What are you going to build?

20
00:02:08,500 --> 00:02:11,040
It's this car.

21
00:06:33,040 --> 00:06:35,580
-And everything should be welded and polished.
Yes.

22
00:06:35,580 --> 00:06:38,700
-It will take an hour or two maybe.
Hahaha.

23
00:06:39,560 --> 00:06:44,360
Here is the size of the rear wheel.

24
00:06:44,360 --> 00:06:48,000
There are 17 "rims but it was not in the right size.

25
00:06:48,780 --> 00:06:57,040
So I got to buy these rims and cut up and narrow off the rim so they should fit the tires I bought.

26
00:06:57,040 --> 00:07:00,440
You can see on the inside where the cormorant is.

27
00:07:00,440 --> 00:07:05,180
A snobbring will be mounted so you do not see the welding joint.

28
00:07:05,180 --> 00:07:09,240
It should be founded before I put on the snob bridge.

29
00:07:09,240 --> 00:07:15,300
The rutram and here is the shape of the cab so I'll see how it will be.

30
00:07:15,300 --> 00:07:22,660
All this is made of aluminum that is filled with chemical metal to gain stability.

31
00:07:22,780 --> 00:07:25,520
Then it becomes like a molded piece.

32
00:07:25,520 --> 00:07:28,480
The cab will be glued on this plate.

33
00:07:28,500 --> 00:07:32,020
So you can fold it down like this.

34
00:07:32,020 --> 00:07:35,280
There is a lock on here on top.

35
00:07:35,280 --> 00:07:40,120
It will be a brass plate with keyhole.

36
00:07:40,120 --> 00:07:42,260
And then a spring in stainless steel.

37
00:07:42,260 --> 00:07:45,120
This spring is provisional.

38
00:07:45,120 --> 00:07:51,860
The principle is that you use a spring as a lock.

39
00:12:20,360 --> 00:12:24,500
-You are the man of details.
That's the fun.

40
00:12:24,500 --> 00:12:28,560
You can come up with something then manufacture it.

41
00:12:28,560 --> 00:12:34,040
These are window hooks used on windows on the inside.

42
00:12:34,040 --> 00:12:38,600
It is spring loaded and you can adjust the hardness.

43
00:12:38,600 --> 00:12:44,480
They will be locks for inspection hatches on the engine.
I thought the style fit well.

44
00:12:44,480 --> 00:12:53,520
Most screws and bolts are recessed.

45
00:12:53,860 --> 00:12:56,800
But original was everything riveted.

46
00:12:57,180 --> 00:13:00,740
Then I have turned rivets in brass.

47
00:13:00,740 --> 00:13:08,180
And will be mounted here and glued.
So it looks riveted as it was original.

48
00:13:08,180 --> 00:13:14,800
A therapy work when you are a little tired.
Then you can stand at the lathe and do these.

49
00:13:15,260 --> 00:13:18,980
Only ordinary brass is polished.

1
00:00:45,780 --> 00:00:47,700
Tjena, Douglas.
Sven Billred.

2
00:00:48,160 --> 00:00:52,340
-Jag har hört talas om att du ska göra ett projekt?
Ja det stämmer.

3
00:00:52,340 --> 00:00:57,780
-När ska den vara klar?
Förhoppningsvis till Elmia 2019.

4
00:00:59,220 --> 00:01:00,860
Det ska gå.

5
00:01:00,860 --> 00:01:05,520
-Finns det någon skiss på hur den ska se ut?

6
00:01:05,520 --> 00:01:08,320
Jo, det mesta finns i huvudet redan.

7
00:01:08,320 --> 00:01:12,340
Men så hittade jag en bild på internet på en bil.

8
00:01:12,340 --> 00:01:14,940
Den här är ganska snarlik.

9
00:01:14,940 --> 00:01:18,780
Jag kommer inte använda
någon motorhuv eller skärmar.

10
00:01:18,780 --> 00:01:24,600
Själva stilen kommer vara såhär med boat-tail
bak och fronten med liknande lyktor.

11
00:01:24,600 --> 00:01:29,100
-Vad har du för bakgrund?
Att du har byggt fler bilar kan väggen bevisa.

12
00:01:29,100 --> 00:01:35,600
Jo, jag har bygget en Chevrolet från 1927
som jag har brukat i 10 år.

13
00:01:35,600 --> 00:01:43,880
Jag har även en Willys från 1939 som var en
4 dörrars som jag har byggt till en Coupe.

14
00:01:43,880 --> 00:01:48,180
Exakt efter originalet.
Och det är den enda i Sverige.

15
00:01:48,180 --> 00:01:54,200
Det finns några Willys Couper från
1940-41 men dom är ovanliga.

16
00:01:54,200 --> 00:01:58,900
-Häftigt! Om ni funderar vad som låter
så är det ett lysrör som knarrar.

17
00:01:58,900 --> 00:02:03,740
Det är ett gammalt garage.
Jag har varit här i över 30 år.

18
00:02:03,740 --> 00:02:06,420
Det skulle nog behöva renoverats.

19
00:02:06,420 --> 00:02:08,500
-Vad är det du ska bygga?

20
00:02:08,500 --> 00:02:11,040
Det är den här bilen.

21
00:06:33,040 --> 00:06:35,580
-Och allt ska svetsas och poleras.
Ja.

22
00:06:35,580 --> 00:06:38,700
-Det kommer ju ta en timme eller två kanske.
Hahaha.

23
00:06:39,560 --> 00:06:44,360
Här är storleken på bakhjulet.

24
00:06:44,360 --> 00:06:48,000
Det är 17" fälgar men det fanns inte i rätt mått.

25
00:06:48,780 --> 00:06:57,040
Så jag fick köpa dessa fälgar och kapa upp och smalna av fälgen så dom ska passa däcken jag har köpt.

26
00:06:57,040 --> 00:07:00,440
Man kan se på insidan var skarven är.

27
00:07:00,440 --> 00:07:05,180
Det kommer monteras en snobbring
så man inte ser svetsskarven.

28
00:07:05,180 --> 00:07:09,240
Den ska grundlackas innan jag sätter på snobbringen.

29
00:07:09,240 --> 00:07:15,300
Rutramen och här är formen på cabben
så jag ska se hur den ska bli.

30
00:07:15,300 --> 00:07:22,660
Allt detta är gjort i aluminium som är fyllda med kemisktmetall för att få stabilitet.

31
00:07:22,780 --> 00:07:25,520
Då blir det som en gjuten bit.

32
00:07:25,520 --> 00:07:28,480
Cabben kommer att limmas på denna plåt.

33
00:07:28,500 --> 00:07:32,020
Så man kan fälla ner den såhär.

34
00:07:32,020 --> 00:07:35,280
Det sitter en låsning på här ovanpå.

35
00:07:35,280 --> 00:07:40,120
Det ska bli en mässingsplåt med nyckelhål.

36
00:07:40,120 --> 00:07:42,260
Och sedan en fjäder i rostfritt.

37
00:07:42,260 --> 00:07:45,120
Den här fjädern är provisorisk.

38
00:07:45,120 --> 00:07:51,860
Principen är att man använder en fjäder som ett lås.

39
00:12:20,360 --> 00:12:24,500
-Du är detaljernas man.
Det är det som är det roliga.

40
00:12:24,500 --> 00:12:28,560
Man kan hitta på något sedan tillverka det.

41
00:12:28,560 --> 00:12:34,040
Det här är fönsterhakar som
användes på fönster på insidan.

42
00:12:34,040 --> 00:12:38,600
Den är fjäderbelastad och
man kan justera hårdheten.

43
00:12:38,600 --> 00:12:44,480
Dom kommer sitta lås till inspektionsluckor på motorn.
Jag tyckte stilen passade bra.

44
00:12:44,480 --> 00:12:53,520
Dom flesta skruvar och bultar är försänkta.

45
00:12:53,860 --> 00:12:56,800
Men original var allt nitat.

46
00:12:57,180 --> 00:13:00,740
Då har jag svarvat nitar i mässing.

47
00:13:00,740 --> 00:13:08,180
Och kommer monteras här och limmas.
Så det ser nitat ut som det var original.

48
00:13:08,180 --> 00:13:14,800
Ett terapiarbete när man är lite trött.
Då kan man stå vid svarven och göra dessa.

49
00:13:15,260 --> 00:13:18,980
Det är bara vanlig mässing som poleras upp.

1
00:00:41,460 --> 00:00:44,700
It has happened a little neighbor since last time.
Yes some.

2
00:00:44,700 --> 00:00:49,720
I have to get the body ready.
I've started here.

3
00:00:49,720 --> 00:00:54,600
These plates and this door are done.

4
00:00:54,600 --> 00:00:58,460
The foundation is clear but it must be directed.

5
00:00:58,460 --> 00:01:02,720
It is a bit wavy after the English wheel.

6
00:01:02,720 --> 00:01:09,260
It should be directed and smoothed out with armored file before starting to grind.

7
00:01:09,260 --> 00:01:13,300
I have also made the moldings that will sit over the joints.

8
00:01:13,300 --> 00:01:17,000
It's a front list, here.

9
00:01:17,000 --> 00:01:21,380
I have had to shape it a bit because the convertible to lie against.

10
00:01:21,380 --> 00:01:24,500
So I've had to lower it a bit.

11
00:01:24,500 --> 00:01:32,360
This list is measured adapted.
It sits so tight so it can hardly be removed.

12
00:01:32,740 --> 00:01:36,480
There is a screw bracket at the forefront.

13
00:01:36,480 --> 00:01:39,560
So you attach it there and also to the back.

14
00:01:39,580 --> 00:01:45,600
The strip is attached like this and then it is angled in place at the forefront.

15
00:01:45,600 --> 00:01:49,040
From the beginning, this is a Volvo Amazon List.

16
00:01:49,040 --> 00:01:53,535
As I have been directed because it has been bent in all directions.

17
00:01:53,540 --> 00:01:59,360
Then I have heated the strip and stretch it out so it becomes completely straight.

18
00:01:59,360 --> 00:02:03,220
Then you have to weld this one so it has something to attach in.

19
00:02:03,220 --> 00:02:07,175
It can be tricky as it is thin material in stainless steel.

20
00:02:07,180 --> 00:02:11,380
It goes well if you are careful.

21
00:02:12,220 --> 00:02:18,280
It is the same type of strip but I have narrowed it so it gets pointed.

22
00:02:18,300 --> 00:02:21,280
And got another shape at the bottom.

23
00:02:21,280 --> 00:02:26,840
I have done this because the joint is much more pointed.
Then there had been air in between.

24
00:02:26,840 --> 00:02:29,960
Now I have made the list a little narrower.

25
00:02:30,820 --> 00:02:36,920
The width up here is the same.
The strip then becomes narrower all the way down.

26
00:02:57,380 --> 00:03:04,060
-You have dressed the entire rear!
Well it went better than expected actually.

27
00:03:04,060 --> 00:03:09,640
-This was paper last time I was here?
Yes it was cardboard.

28
00:03:09,660 --> 00:03:12,880
Since then I have finished the inner frame.

29
00:03:12,880 --> 00:03:15,160
I finished it only then the painting I frame.

30
00:03:15,160 --> 00:03:18,320
Then you template the frame and cut a plate.

31
00:03:18,320 --> 00:03:24,380
It will be a long plate.
This plate has been elected in one piece.

32
00:03:24,380 --> 00:03:26,820
And here is the cormorant.

33
00:03:26,820 --> 00:03:33,300
It is not so easy when you are alone and should roll such a long plate in the English wheel.

34
00:03:33,300 --> 00:03:39,040
Do not have friends who show up here?
Yes, but they don't like to work.

35
00:03:42,300 --> 00:03:49,640
You reinforce by adding an angle profile at the whole frame.

36
00:03:49,640 --> 00:03:59,160
I attach the plate with welding bars so I get stiffness in the plate so I can roll the plate back and forth.

37
00:03:59,480 --> 00:04:05,220
When I start rolling the plate, it becomes stiffer.

38
00:04:05,220 --> 00:04:10,820
Then everything should be fitted.
Everything is hand -knocked around all falsaries.

39
00:04:10,820 --> 00:04:14,180
It is not possible to do with a machine so it is the hammer that applies.

40
00:04:14,180 --> 00:04:15,775
-What job!

41
00:04:15,780 --> 00:04:21,940
-The difficult is to make two equal sides.
Making one is easier but the other must be equal.

42
00:04:21,940 --> 00:04:26,520
I do not build this body that other car builders do.

43
00:04:26,520 --> 00:04:34,080
They build fish skeletons in wood with wooden boards and then shape the plate after that.

44
00:04:34,080 --> 00:04:38,680
Then you can oppose the plate and check that it fits.

45
00:04:39,260 --> 00:04:44,380
I don't like working with wood ...

46
00:04:44,380 --> 00:04:48,800
Then I would rather do this and template until it gets right.

47
00:04:48,800 --> 00:04:52,760
It may take longer but it doesn't matter.

48
00:05:22,020 --> 00:05:28,720
Should you collide with this car, you have to make the parts because they cannot be purchased.

49
00:05:28,720 --> 00:05:34,360
The lock to the door sits here on the inside.

50
00:05:35,380 --> 00:05:38,500
It's sitting here.

51
00:05:39,420 --> 00:05:45,760
Now there is a spring here but it will not be needed when there is a rubber list here.

52
00:05:45,760 --> 00:05:48,460
Then the door springs automatically.

53
00:05:49,840 --> 00:05:59,380
Possibly there will be gas pistons or if there is to be a lock in a fixed position.

54
00:05:59,700 --> 00:06:02,720
It works amazingly well.

55
00:06:02,720 --> 00:06:08,420
-Shelt crazy what a job!
There is a lot of millimeter fit.

56
00:06:08,420 --> 00:06:15,140
-This you have done this too.
Yes it is the bottom plate against the frame

57
00:06:15,140 --> 00:06:23,240
Since the frame swings like this, it would have been difficult to get to the line.

58
00:06:27,260 --> 00:06:32,120
Then I thought it was nicer to put in a bit and get a straight line.

59
00:06:32,120 --> 00:06:35,060
Which is consistent with this line.

60
00:06:35,060 --> 00:06:41,180
Then there are 5 of these that reinforce.

61
00:06:41,180 --> 00:06:43,160
All the way down.

62
00:06:43,160 --> 00:06:47,220
We have previously seen a template in cardboard.

63
00:06:47,220 --> 00:06:52,520
These are made of stainless steel and I have welded the end together.

64
00:06:52,520 --> 00:06:57,540
I will glue screws on the back.

65
00:06:57,540 --> 00:07:00,920
Which is worn into the holes and screwed up.

66
00:07:00,920 --> 00:07:08,400
Here on the edge, a friend has made small brass hats coming ...

67
00:07:19,480 --> 00:07:22,340
In the next stage it is ...

00:07:22,340 --> 00:07:25,040
